Name: Becoming Familiar
Author: Krutonium
Description:
This mod works similar to Friendship Decay if you're in the same area as an NPC; Granting just a little more friendship by default than you'd lose from the friendship decay. Basically, they see you across the room and are happy!

Mod is configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu!

Downloads.Description:
Changelog:
Marry-able and Single Forever NPC's are now given different dialog
Kids no longer fall in love with you. Instead they are Adorable
Attempted to make it so that it wouldn't show notifications of SH's Wild Animals NPC's. Let me know if more!
